_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'RESOURCE MANAGEMENT PLAN' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.06.01.

f01_Resource_Identification_Strategy.label: Resource Identification Strategy
f01_Resource_Identification_Strategy.guidance: Methods used to identify human, equipment, and material resources needed for project execution.

f02_Resource_Acquisition_and_Staffing_Ap.label: Resource Acquisition and Staffing Approach
f02_Resource_Acquisition_and_Staffing_Ap.guidance: Protocols for internal resource assignment, external hiring, and contracting.

f03_Key_Project_Roles_and_Competency_Pro.label: Key Project Roles and Competency Profiles
f03_Key_Project_Roles_and_Competency_Pro.guidance: Definition of core project roles, required qualifications, and skill competencies.

f04_Authority_and_Decision_Making_Bounda.label: Authority and Decision-Making Boundaries
f04_Authority_and_Decision_Making_Bounda.guidance: Authorized decision limits for technical leads, project managers, and supervisors.

f05_Project_Organizational_Chart_and_Hie.label: Project Organizational Chart and Hierarchy
f05_Project_Organizational_Chart_and_Hie.guidance: Visual or structured hierarchy outlining reporting lines and team organizational units.

f06_Resource_Management_Governance.label: Resource Management Governance
f06_Resource_Management_Governance.guidance: Policies governing resource allocation, conflicts of priority, and workload balancing.

f07_Team_Building_and_Development_Initia.label: Team Building and Development Initiatives
f07_Team_Building_and_Development_Initia.guidance: Structured activities and coaching designed to enhance team cohesion and performance.

f08_Required_Training_and_Certification_.label: Required Training and Certification Programs
f08_Required_Training_and_Certification_.guidance: Mandatory technical, safety, or process training required for team members.

f09_Equipment_and_Material_Logistics.label: Equipment and Material Logistics
f09_Equipment_and_Material_Logistics.guidance: Procurement, storage, utilization tracking, and maintenance of physical tools and equipment.

f10_Resource_Release_and_Demobilization_.label: Resource Release and Demobilization Plan
f10_Resource_Release_and_Demobilization_.guidance: Orderly phased release plan for team members and return or disposal of physical equipment.
